key_results: Pilot-assisted optical ELM achieves 0.99 symbol accuracy under weak/moderate turbulence and 0.76 under strong turbulence (4 OAM modes); maintains 0.55 accuracy with 9 OAM modes across all weather conditions; ultra-low latency via passive optical kernel mapping
comments: Innovative hybrid optical-electronic learning paradigm with strong weak-turbulence performance, but symbol accuracy degrades significantly under strong turbulence, limiting practical deployment.

model_io.model: Pilot-assisted optical extreme learning machine for OAM demodulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Interference kernel from pilot beams provides sufficient turbulence correction without deep learning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed for weak/moderate turbulence; accuracy 0.99 for 4 modes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Passive optical nonlinear mapping reduces latency vs. electronic processing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; offloads nonlinear transformation to propagation

title: Rubidium vapor cell spectroscopy by selective reflection approach
task: Characterize selective-reflection ellipsometry from rubidium vapor cells as phase-sensitive spectroscopy platform
key_results: Numerical and experimental ellipsometric parameters (Ψ, Δ) from 50 μm Rb microcell show inverse behavior at complementary angles (30°/60°, 37°/53°) due to wavelength-scale Fabry–Pérot interference and thickness-dependent resonances; thickness-varying from λ/2 to 9λ/4 modifies selective-reflection spectrum
comments: Sophisticated phase-sensitive approach extending conventional scalar reflectivity, but practical advantages over existing Rb-cell-based laser stabilization methods are not clearly articulated.

model_io.model: Fourier-series solution of coupled field-polarization equations in finite Rb vapor layer

hypotheses.hypothesis: Wavelength-scale thickness changes modify selective-reflection spectrum
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; resonant features depend on optical path and Fabry–Pérot interference

hypotheses.hypothesis: Complementary-angle ellipsometric response is physically observable in microcells
hypotheses.result: Confirmed experimentally in 50 μm Rb cell

title: Advances in gate stack development for p-type 2D channel FETs through sacrificial WSe2 bilayer oxidation
task: Develop sacrificial bilayer WSe₂ gate-stack engineering for high-performance p-type 2D FETs with low interface defects
key_results: Selective oxidation of top WSe₂ layer creates WOₓ seed for uniform high-κ nucleation; monolayer WSe₂ channel preserved; Dit = (8–11) × 10¹¹ cm⁻² eV⁻¹; SS = 65 mV/dec; hole mobility = 38–85 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹; on-state current = 108 μA/μm at 1 V overdrive, peak 690 μA/μm; Vt variability minimized via plasma-type selection
comments: Elegant sacrificial-layer approach addressing fundamental challenges in 2D-FET integration with record drive currents, though long-term reliability and scaling to multi-gate architectures require assessment.

model_io.model: Back-gate and dual-gate WSe₂ FETs with sacrificial bilayer oxidation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Selective top-layer oxidation enables uniform high-κ nucleation without channel degradation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; monolayer channel preserved with Dit = (8–11) × 10¹¹ cm⁻² eV⁻¹

hypotheses.hypothesis: Plasma-type selection minimizes Vt variability in dual-gate devices
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; appropriate plasma type reduces Vt shifts

title: Field-induced condensation of π to 2π soliton lattices in chiral magnets
task: Observe field-induced π-to-2π soliton-lattice crossover in chiral magnet Mn₁.₄PtSn via interplay of anisotropy and magnetostatics
key_results: π-chiral soliton lattice (π-CSL) identified as ground state (not spiral phase) evolving into 2π-CSL under out-of-plane field; transition governed by uniaxial magnetocrystalline anisotropy and magnetostatic interactions; double sine-Gordon model qualitatively captures physics; framework extends to D₂d, S₄, Cnᵥ, Cn symmetries
comments: Novel observation of soliton-lattice crossover with clear microscopic mechanism and symmetry generalization, opening new avenues for soliton-based spintronics.

model_io.model: Lorentz TEM, resonant elastic X-ray scattering, and micromagnetic simulation of Mn₁.₄PtSn

hypotheses.hypothesis: π-CSL rather than spiral is ground state in Mn₁.₄PtSn
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via direct imaging

hypotheses.hypothesis: Double sine-Gordon model qualitatively describes π→2π transition
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; anisotropy and magnetostatics drive crossover
